the elative has one tap gloss each, so it shows the wrong one for the construction: in the comparative فَاس أَقْدَمُ مِنْ مَرَّاكُش and quiz plq4 ('older than') the tap says 'the oldest (before a noun)', while in the superlative الْقَاهِرَة أَكْبَرُ مَدِينَة the tap for أَكْبَرُ says 'bigger' (also desert.json quiz[5].explain: أَكْثَرُ=more for 'most of'). errors.fix: أَقْدَمُ = older; (before a noun) the oldest · أَكْبَرُ = bigger; (before a noun) the biggest · أَكْثَرُ = more; (before a noun) most (of)

شَايْ is written with a sukūn on the yāʾ here but شَاي everywhere else in the course (coffee.json, food.json); harmonise the spelling (the sukūn form is not wrong, and it happens to make the engine output the better 'shāy').

summary: Checked all nine Explore chapters (calligraphy, coffee, desert, family, food, places, ramadan, science, souq): every Arabic title, body-text Arabic, example sentence with literal and segs, mistakes pairs, words list, reading and its segs, reading questions and quizzes with answer keys, and the engine transliteration. The Arabic is of a high standard: case after kāna, diptotes (صَحْرَاءَ, مَلَابِسَ, إِسْحَاقَ, مِصْرَ, دِمَشْقَ), accusative أَبَا الْهَوْل, numbers 3-10 and 11-99, verb-first singular agreement and non-human plural agreement are all correct, and every answer key and mistakes pair is right. 12 errors: 1 major (الْمَصْرِيّ for مِصْرِيّ in family.json, with an internal inconsistency against the quiz's 'al-Miṣrī'), 11 minor: two vocalisation gaps in places.json (missing tanwīn on the noun after a superlative, missing case vowels on sentence subjects), seven tap-gloss problems where the single-sense tap dictionary shows a sense from another sentence (وَادِي 'Wadi Musa', يَد 'hand luggage', كَرِيم as a first name in رَمَضَان كَرِيم, يَصُومُ 'they fast' on the isolated verb, الْأَكْبَر 'biggest' for eldest, بَارِدًا '(object)' for a kāna predicate, elatives glossed as superlative in comparatives and vice versa, تَفَضَّلْ 'here you are' beside prose saying 'come in'), and one engine finding (shāī, ḥulū/badū, Wabākistāna, ḥayāh). 13 notes on facts, English wording and consistency; no history or geography statement was found to be wrong.
